home.visionBody: To create a future where every economically disadvantaged student in the upcountry region has equal access to quality education, empowering them to achieve their full potential and contribute to the development of their communities and nation. translate sinhala
home.missionBody: To improve education for economically disadvantaged students in the upcountry region through scholarships, academic support, school resources, and sports development, while reducing the education gap and empowering youth for positive change.
home.whatWeDoSubtitle: From classrooms to community life, our six key areas of work support the dreams of upcountry students and the progress of their communities
home.item1Body: We expand learning opportunities through free educational seminars, model examinations, online classes and teaching support..
home.item2Body: We help students overcome financial barriers through scholarships and monthly assistance for university students, enabling them to continue their education
home.item3Body: We support students and families through educational awareness, emergency relief and medical assistance.
home.item4Body: We engage young people in community service and improve educational facilities, working towards our vision of “A Graduate in Every Home.
home.item5Body: We strengthen community connections and sustain our educational initiatives through May Day celebrations, community gatherings and cultural fundraising events.
home.item6Body: We nurture students talents, confidence, leadership and teamwork through sports, arts and co-curricular activities.
